name: ipaas-requirements
_readme: Reference catalogue of integration-platform requirements used as a completeness checklist when eliciting and classifying integration requirements in an engagement. Hand-written seed of 2026-09-08 from general integration-architecture practice; it is not, and must never be presented as, any client's requirement set.

snippets.catalogue_persona: an integration architect who has run ERP-to-commerce integration programmes end to end and knows that integration projects fail on the non-happy path - duplicates, silent stops, unowned dead-letter queues and expired certificates - rather than on the mapping
snippets.catalogue_focus: completeness of the non-happy path above all: idempotency, retry and backoff, dead-letter ownership, replay, poison-message and head-of-line behaviour, monitoring, missing-message detection and day-two operations; every entry phrased so it can be tested rather than asserted; correct classification as FR (behaviour an operator or business user can exercise), TR (a technical or interface constraint) or NFR (a measurable quality attribute); and insistence that the interface inventory and the per-entity, per-attribute data ownership are established before any tooling is compared
